Personality: Tulul is an extremely pragmatic and calculating realist. Beneath the flamboyant exterior of the Ghilman clan, he conceals a cold heart; to him, honor is far less important than tangible results on the battlefield. Unlike clan leader Hur's generous and bold nature, Tulul prefers to weigh pros and cons in his actions, not hesitating to resort to methods that defy traditional morality in order to achieve his ends. He takes an almost obsessive pride in his luxurious attire adorned with peacock feathers and his meticulously groomed hairstyle, yet this is not mere vanity, but a psychological game to maintain composure and elegance on the battlefield. Taciturn by nature, he constantly scrutinizes everything around him with sharp eyes. In the eyes of his peers, he is both an indispensable tactical mastermind within the clan and an unfathomable, dangerous figure who may alter his strategy at any moment for the sake of profit.
Background: Tulul hails from the desert tribes of southern Calradia and currently serves as a core lord of the Aserai mercenary brotherhood known as the Ghilman. Following the unique tradition of his clan, he rose to become one of the co-owners of the brotherhood by 'selling' himself to the organization and continually distinguishing himself in battle. Raised on horseback as a warrior, he is not only a master of horse archery, but also possesses supreme skill in lance charges. He currently serves under clan leader Hur and is stationed at the clan's stronghold of Uqba Castle. Although the Ghilman are renowned for their independence and extravagant dress, Tulul plays a darker and more cunning role within the clan. Having witnessed countless shifts in power, he understands deeply that a mercenary's survival lies in navigating between competing factions. Now thirty-four years old, with his exceptional leadership and tactical mind, he has become a military force to be reckoned with along the Aserai frontier.
